definition: Offline reconstruction on recorded BDF dense polynomials. System entropy includes ideal-gas mixture, pure liquid and fixed-amount quartz entropy differences. Independent scalar face entropy and external reservoir entropy changes are quadrature-integrated. Targets are numerical research budgets, not universal second-law or material certification.
entropy_reference: The constant quartz entropy reference cancels from changes because its amount is fixed. Gas/liquid standard entropies use the recorded source convention; formation-energy offsets cancel correctly through chemical potentials.
validity: Only the declared conditional channel and sampled/dense numerical trajectory. No proof for arbitrary states, constitutive parameters or unresolved roots.
